name: colcoor
description: Drive the Colcoor conversation orchestrator from Claude Desktop via the same backend the Cursor extension uses.
long_description: Colcoor is a structured conversation orchestrator (event graph, side chat, notes, stars, branches). This extension lets Claude Desktop list and create conversations, traverse the main-thread event tree, append user messages and assistant replies, manage members, and post side-chat messages. All operations go through the existing Colcoor HTTP backend; no Colcoor code is bundled in the extension.

backend_url.title: Colcoor backend URL
backend_url.description: Origin only (no path, no trailing slash). e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000 for local uvicorn, http://127.0.0.1 for local docker-compose nginx, https://your-host for a deployed VM.

api_token.title: Colcoor API JWT (optional)
api_token.description: Pre-issued Colcoor JWT obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/cursor. Leave blank to sign in interactively via the colcoor_sign_in_with_cursor tool.

cursor_access_token.title: Cursor / VS Code IdP access token (optional)
cursor_access_token.description: If provided and `api_token` is empty, the extension exchanges this token for a Colcoor JWT on startup via POST /api/v1/auth/cursor (see docs/authentication.md).

provider_hint.title: Identity provider hint
provider_hint.description: Used alongside `cursor_access_token`. One of: auto, github, microsoft, google.

agent_author.title: Author label for assistant messages
agent_author.description: String stored in `events.author` when Claude appends an `assistant_output` via colcoor_append_assistant_message. Default: claude_desktop.

request_timeout_ms.title: Per-request timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for backend HTTP requests. Increase if your backend is remote and slow.
